run_sample_speech_dlm: run the SpeechDLM model to generate speech unit sequences from an input file with a checkpoint
run_sample_speech_dlm_beam_search: run the SpeechDLM model with beam search to generate speech unit sequences from input data
run_sample_speech_dlm_sampling: run the SpeechDLM model with top-k and top-p sampling to generate speech unit sequences
